title: Oracle Price Aggregation
description: Computes the aggregate price a decentralized oracle network would publish from a set of individual submissions, under four mechanism-named aggregation rules: median-filtered confidence-weighted mean, stake-weighted median on the frequency convention, three-vote confidence median, and plain median with an f-of-n readout. Supports an optional prev_print_hash citing the prior print of the same pair, which turns a series of same-pair prints into a walkable chain; omitting it reproduces the unlinked-print output byte for byte. Every price, weight, confidence, timestamp and submitter id is supplied and asserted, never fetched (zero-egress). Simulates the aggregation step only, does not model the commit-reveal phase, and never claims any real network did or would publish this number. A submitter id may be supplied as a sha256-salted@1 commitment (SPEC.md §25) to withhold the identifier while keeping the aggregation bound to it. Not a price feed and not a market-data source.

Not run through scripts/generate-node-manifest.mjs -- that generator reads the assembled chaingraph.json and this is a shard-only D-class WU that never touches the monolith (board/RIDER-KERNEL.md).

not_proven.detail: Every price, weight, confidence, timestamp and submitter id is caller-supplied and asserted. This kernel performs no oracle-network, price-feed or market-data lookups (zero-egress) and does not verify any submission against an external source.

This kernel simulates the aggregation step only. The commit-reveal phase that precedes aggregation in most real oracle networks is not modelled, so nothing here shows whether a submission was validly committed before it was revealed.

The aggregate computed here is what the named mechanism yields on the supplied submissions. It is not a claim that any real oracle network did, or would, publish this number for this pair at this epoch.
The outlier penalty rate is computed from the stated formula as an informative readout. This kernel does not assert that any penalty was applied, by whom, or under whose rulebook.
